About me INFJ personality type

Program Manager by profession. Curious human by nature.

I turn complex, ambiguous strategies into shipped, measurable products. Over the last decade at companies like Amazon, Xometry, Condé Nast, and L'Oréal, I've bridged the gap between engineering and business leadership to deliver high-impact initiatives. From global AI rollouts and vulnerability burndowns to multi-million-dollar AWS cost optimizations, I focus on end-to-end delivery. I connect the right people around a plan they trust and numbers they can watch move.

Beyond the work

When I'm not steering technical programs, I explore a different side of complexity. I'm fascinated by symbolism, intuition, consciousness, and the underlying patterns that connect human experiences, and I previously practiced as a registered tarot reader, which deepened my respect for pattern recognition and intuitive problem-solving. I also dabble in numerology and Vastu, and can still finish a gripping novel in a single day.

I'm equally drawn to science fiction, mythology, and emerging technology, ideas that make me question what's possible, whether that means imagining another world, understanding how AI is changing ours, or looking at an old story from a completely different perspective. And then there's the grounded side of me: family, wellness, creativity, and continuously trying to become a little better than I was yesterday.
